milestones.title: Find and retire work
milestones.scope: Search/filter, archive, inspect archived work and unarchive; current four-lane workflow.

milestones.title: Organize related work
milestones.scope: Parent/child hierarchy and typed links; no automatic lane/priority changes.

milestones.title: Create and reopen configured workflows
milestones.scope: Initialize synthetic boards with configured lanes/labels/transitions and human/bot rules; reopen safely. Existing-board policy editing and Attention integration follow separately.

milestones.title: Change workflows and show truthful Attention
milestones.scope: Update supported existing-board workflows, stable labels/IDs and compatibility/refusal; project configured Attention categories. No new workflow engine.

milestones.title: Add, inspect and download card files
milestones.scope: Ordinary browser/CLI attach, list, inspect, download and detach; attribution/history and retained bytes remain correct. Keep existing limits/storage foundations.

milestones.title: Use covers and preserve attachment consistency
milestones.scope: Choose/clear covers and recover from ordinary failures; verify retained references, bytes and supported export/restore after attachment operations.

milestones.title: Run useful board-change alerts
milestones.scope: Explicit monitor targets/lifecycle, bot-only suppression and honest pending/delivery state; exercise only synthetic/local delivery. External delivery remains opt-in and separately authorized.

milestones.title: Publish optional Git snapshots and backups
milestones.scope: Opt-in Git-readable board publishing/backup, bounded failure/retry status and exact included files; board saves remain independent. Synthetic/local destination; remote credentials/push activation require explicit authorization.

milestones.title: Update and restart the local application
milestones.scope: Bounded maintainable local update/start/restart/reopen workflow, visible build/status and recovery guide; preserve ownership, drafts and original UNKNOWN/no replay. No installer/platform expansion.

milestones.title: Inventory a V1 board and preview import
milestones.scope: Read-only synthetic V1 inventory/dry-run with capability/compatibility report, ID/policy/history/reference accounting and unsupported-input refusals. No destination activation.

milestones.title: Import logical V1 board data into an isolated copy
milestones.scope: Import synthetic actors/policy/cards/IDs/tickets, relationships, comments and committed history into an isolated SQLite destination; validate all logical counts/references and refuse unsafe input. Attachment bytes follow separately; partial output is not adoption-ready.

milestones.title: Complete imported attachment bytes and references
milestones.scope: Copy exact synthetic attachment bytes, metadata/covers and retained references into the isolated import; verify hashes, missing/corrupt-file refusal and coherent export/restore. No real source mutation or activation.

milestones.title: Rehearse V1 coexistence and recovery
milestones.scope: Exercise the complete synthetic imported board through ordinary browser/CLI, preserve the V1 source, prove coexistence and rollback/recovery; prepare the adoption checklist. Named real sources/destinations and cutover still need owner authorization.

milestones.title: Reconcile the retained feature-parity outcomes
milestones.scope: Trace documented V1 outcomes to delivered evidence or owner-approved differences; identify gaps as separately scoped small work rather than hiding implementation in final acceptance. No full-parity claim with open gaps.

milestones.title: Qualify and hand off the everyday release
milestones.scope: Run the final ordinary multi-board browser/CLI, restart/recovery, backup/restore and applicable optional-operations regression on the bound candidate; independent candidate/report review and usable release handoff. Reuse milestone evidence, refresh changed boundaries; new gaps become separate bounded work.
